Lounge 3.0: rebuilt as a native app — faster, lighter, no web view underneath.

- **Native from top to bottom.** The whole interface is now drawn natively (Slint) instead of in a web view, in one self-contained Lounge.exe — no WebView2, no browser engine.
- **Every screen rebuilt:** Home, the libraries, game, movie and show pages, Search, Settings, Stats, Transfers, the remote browser, Apps, the controller tester, the quick menu, now playing and updates.
- **Battery details.** Tap the battery in the top bar (or Battery in the quick menu) for the current power draw in watts, time left or time to full, capacity, battery health, voltage and charge cycles.
- **Less memory.** Artwork and GPU caches are capped, so Lounge stays small however long you browse.
- **Controllers are read through XInput**, like 2.x.

Known gaps: no blur effects and some entrance animations are missing; PlayStation and Switch controllers over Bluetooth aren't supported yet (Xbox controllers are).
